ROOT.scriptdef: IF EXISTS (SELECT Name,xtype FROM sysobjects WHERE Name='ZrodloProlongaty' AND xtype in (N'FN', N'IF', N'TF', N'FS', N'FT')) drop function CDN.ZrodloProlongaty;

CREATE FUNCTION [CDN].[ZrodloProlongaty] (@prle_id int,@prle_lp int) RETURNS @wynik TABLE ( Typ int, Numer int, Lp int ) AS BEGIN declare @trpNumer int,@trpTyp int,@trpLp int while(1=1) begin select @trpNumer = 0, @trpTyp = 0 select @trpNumer = prle_zrdnumer, @trpTyp = prle_zrdtyp, @trpLp = prle_zrdlp from CDN.ProlongElem where prle_prlnid = @prle_id and PRLE_Lp = @prle_lp IF not @trpTyp in (7942,7943) break select @prle_lp = trp_prlelp,@prle_id = TrP_GIDNumer from CDN.TraPlat where @trpNumer = trp_gidnumer and @trpTyp = trp_gidtyp and @trpLp = trp_gidlp IF @prle_lp=0 break end insert into @wynik select @trpTyp,@trpNumer,@trpLp RETURN END
GRANT SELECT ON CDN.ZrodloProlongaty TO CDNRaport
